description: One invoice, bill or expense with its lines and status: draft or posted, when it was sent and viewed, total, paid, amount still due, and whether it is overdue. An invoice also says where its automatic payment reminders stand: on or off for the books, paused for this invoice, the day of the next one or why none is coming, and how many went out, and whether its goods are ready for pickup, picked up, shipped or delivered. Also a link to open it in Mobile Accounting.

bookId.description: The set of books, from list_books.

documentId.description: The document id, from find_documents or a draft tool.
